prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity full-canvas desktop web application screenshot, 1664×928, no browser chrome or device frame.
Primary request: Redesign QianCraft 文化文创智能工作台 for a live judging presentation while keeping it fully usable as an evidence-driven node editor. Avoid both enterprise blandness and sci-fi spectacle.
Composition — Prism Stage: a compact translucent top phase navigator; a 64px left rail; a 230px source dock; a large central diagonal stage; a floating-but-docked 330px inspector at right. The workflow reads as a stepped diagonal from upper-left evidence to lower-right design output: 文化 and 市场 feed 策略, then Design Brief, then 视觉方向; concept A/B/C form a controlled three-lane prism on the lower half and resolve into 概念海报. Put the selected concept “针格模块｜花溪挑花互动冰箱贴（概念样）” on the visual foreground plane with a small authentic product thumbnail placeholder, provenance label and explicit 概念样 boundary. Keep all other nodes as compact editable instruments.
Real content to show legibly: QianCraft; 文化 / 市场 / 策略 / 设计 / 交付; 文化证据 22, 市场样本 378, 机会方向 8; Human Decision v2; status labels 已完成, 待更新, 缓存; actions “运行工作流”, “比较 A/B/C”, “打开详情”.
Visual world: sophisticated Mesh Gradient + Glassmorphism. A dark ink canvas with asymmetric indigo, amethyst, teal and restrained apricot mesh fields; layered glass planes create stage depth. Top bar and major docks use smoky translucent navy with fine white-alpha borders; only the selected concept plane receives a brighter frosted glass surface and prismatic edge. Shadows must prove actual overlap. Use subtle grain and crisp vector-like connectors. Chinese neo-grotesk typography, 13–16px body, 26px inspector heading, restrained roundness.
Judging narrative: the eye should follow evidence → decision → concept → deliverable without reading instructions. The center remains an operating canvas with zoom, drag, evidence, inspector and Run controls.
Constraints: no marketing hero, no giant slogan, no analytics bento, no floating card soup, no empty showcase composition, no neon cyberpunk HUD, no full-screen rainbow gradient, no stock people, no fabricated compliance or sales claims, no decorative ethnic pattern, no device frame, no watermark, no unreadable tiny UI text.
